# Growmetrik

> Digital Growth Agency in Hyderabad specializing in on-site Reels video shoots, hyper-local Meta ads, social media management, and mobile-first websites for retail clothing stores, bridal boutiques, and salons.

## Overview
- **Name:** Growmetrik
- **Website:** https://growmetrik.in
- **Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- **Core Market:** Retail clothing boutiques, saree houses, salons, bridal studios, and local stores in Hyderabad
- **Offer Model:** 14-day ₹0 agency fee trial. No advance. Measure real walk-ins and WhatsApp enquiries before paying.
- **Founders:** Likith (Meta Ads & Local Strategy) & Sharan (Content & Creative Direction)
- **Direct WhatsApp:** +91-80748-32297 (https://wa.me/918074832297)
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/growmetrik.in

## Core Services
1. **Social Media Management:** 3–5 posts/week, daily stories, weekly content calendars, offer highlights, and plain monthly reports.
2. **Reels & Video Shoots:** On-site filming in Hyderabad with strong 3-second shopper hooks, crisp mobile edits, and clear price/collection callouts.
3. **Local Meta Ads:** Targeted Instagram and Facebook ads strictly within a 5–10 km radius of the physical shop in Hyderabad. 100% direct billing in client's Meta account (zero ad spend markup).
4. **Website Design:** Fast 4G mobile-first store websites featuring Google Maps pin directions, instant 1-tap WhatsApp consultation, and showcase catalog grids.

## Case Study Proof
- **Client:** Sri Venkateswara Kids & Women’s Wear (L.B. Nagar, Hyderabad)
- **Single Reel Views:** 62,773
- **Follows from One Reel:** 177
- **Post Saves:** 565
- **90-Day Follower Growth:** +156 verified local followers
